subject: Tiered ramp incentive request and approval for Veridian MAP
messages:
From: Emma Fisher <emma.fisher@veridianhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: tom.alvarez@veridianhealth.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + request for ramped discount tied to milestones

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the MAP internally and Legal asked that we put a concrete ramp incentive into the commercial terms so leadership can greenlight the pilot.

High level ask: a tiered discount tied to milestone commits — pilot PO (50k committed) -> 25% off list for the first 3 months; post-production ramp to 250k ARR -> 15% off list for the following 9 months; if ramp misses milestone 2, a prorated rebate instead of the 15% ongoing.

I attached our MAP template with the dates we discussed (Veridian-MAP-draft.xlsx). Can Redwood confirm whether this structure is within your approval bands or if we need an internal escalation? We’re targeting a signature by May 6 so engineering can start the POC week of May 10.

Thanks —
Emma
Emma Fisher
Head of Integrations, Veridian Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Fisher <emma.fisher@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + request for ramped discount tied to milestones

Emma —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. We can support a tiered structure like the one you outlined. I put together a proposed commercial outline and attached an updated MAP (MAP_v2_tiered-pricing.pdf) and a draft SOW (SOW-Veridian-v1.3.docx) for review. Key points: 

- Pilot commitment: $50,000 payable on signature -> 25% off list for first 3 months of service.
- Ramp milestone: if > $250k ARR within 90 days of prod launch -> 15% off for next 9 months.
- Missed ramp: prorated rebate based on utilization.
- Payment terms: 30 days net; discounts applied on invoice lines per milestone.

Before we give final commercial approval, I need an internal confirmation for the 25% play and the conditional 15% runway. Copying Marissa for deal ops and Laura for finance sign-off. Can you confirm Veridian is ok with the payment cadence and the milestone definition in the MAP?

Best,
Soojin

Hi Ben & Laura —

Heads-up: Veridian (potential ARR ramp to 250k) has requested a MAP with a 25% pilot discount on a $50k committed PO and a conditional 15% discount if they hit the ramp target within 90 days. Drafts attached.

Why this matters: the pilot is time-sensitive (customer is asking to start POC the week of 5/10). If we can approve the 25% pilot discount and the conditional 15% as a time-bound runway, we can accelerate to signature and materially increase our chance to win their enterprise business.

Request: please approve the commercial as-is OR flag any changes. If this requires exec-level signoff, can we escalate now? I’ve included the exact language for the MAP milestone and rebate calculation in the attached MAP_v2.

Thanks,
Soojin

Soojin —

Quick clarifying Qs for the record before I escalate to finance execs:
- Is the $50k pilot a non-refundable committed PO or is it refundable pro rata if the pilot is cancelled?
- Are the discounts applied to list price for compute/inference only, or to total contract value (includes support & onboarding)?
- Billing cadence = invoice on signature for pilot, then monthly for consumption?

If the $50k is non-refundable and the discounts are limited to product lines, we can consider the 25% pilot playbook. Anything that reduces post-launch cash realization (e.g., applying discounts to professional services) will need CFO signoff. Marking this for CFO review; please provide the requested clarifications so I can route.

Looping you in for final signoff. Summary: 25% pilot discount on $50k committed PO (non-refundable on signature) and conditional 15% post-ramp for 9 months contingent on hitting $250k ARR inside 90 days. Finance has asked for confirmation that discounts exclude services and onboarding. Soojin confirmed: discounts apply to product/inference line items only; services remain at list.

Recommendation: approve subject to these conditions (non-refundable pilot PO; discounts limited to product lines; standard 30-day payment terms). Given the strategic nature of Veridian and the timing, I support escalation for the 25% pilot.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: Tiered MAP incentives and next steps (RDW-3452)

Emma —

Thanks for your patience — we’ve secured internal approval. Final commercial summary below and attachments are included (MAP_v2_tiered-pricing.pdf, SOW-Veridian-v1.3.docx):

1) Pilot: $50,000 committed PO, payable on signature (non-refundable). Redwood will apply 25% discount to product/inference line items for the first 3 months post-start.
2) Ramp: If Veridian achieves > $250k ARR within 90 days of production launch, Redwood will apply a 15% discount to product/inference line items for the subsequent 9 months.
3) Missed ramp: If milestone not met, customer is eligible for a prorated rebate calculated on product usage for the first 90 days.
4) Services & onboarding are billed at list and are not subject to the product discounts.
5) Payment: 30 days net.

Next steps:
- I’ve uploaded the execution package to DocuSign: https://redwood.okta.com/app/docu-sign/0ABC1234 — please review and sign by May 6 to keep the POC start date of May 10.
- Legal: Veridian Legal and our counsel to reconcile a clean SOW and MAP appendix.

If that timeline works, I’ll coordinate internal enablement for onboarding and loop in Solutions Engineering for kickoff.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v2_tiered-pricing.pdf (updated milestone language), SOW-Veridian-v1.3.docx
